articles.summary: DENVER, Oct. 31, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — EverCommerce Inc. (NASDAQ: EVCM) (“EverCommerce” or the “Company”), a leading service commerce platform, today announced that it has sold its Marketing Technology solutions to Ignite Visibility.
